register_eigen_matrix_pretty_printer: register the EigenMatrixChildProvider synthetic formatter for Eigen::Matrix types in LLDB
register_eigen_sparse_matrix_pretty_prin: register the EigenSparseMatrixChildProvider synthetic formatter for Eigen::SparseMatrix types in LLDB
inspect_eigen_matrix_children: use EigenMatrixChildProvider to inspect all elements of an Eigen::Matrix during LLDB debugging
get_eigen_matrix_element_at_index: use get_child_at_index to retrieve a specific element by row and column from an Eigen::Matrix
inspect_eigen_sparse_matrix_nonzeros: use EigenSparseMatrixChildProvider to inspect non-zero elements and dimensions of an Eigen::SparseMatrix in LLDB
